UNI-SPAN HEIGHT SAFETY PTY LTD is the Australian entity of the broader Uni-Span Group, a specialist in formwork and scaffolding solutions for construction and infrastructure projects. Operating since at least 2006, the company provides and hires out Quickstage scaffolding systems, custom formwork solutions, and engineering support, serving industries such as civil, commercial, and power generation.

We are seeking skilled and qualified Riggers to join our team in NSW and QLD.

As a Rigger you will be responsible for assembling, installing rigging gears (such as cables, ropes, pulleys and winches), operating, and repairing rigging equipment to lift, move, and position heavy materials and machinery.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Determine the necessary type and size of rigging gear, and inspect and prepare the appropriate rigging gear/equipment for the task before use and ensure compliance with safety regulations
Attach rigging gear to equipment, structural steel or other heavy objects
Communicate with operators and crew to guide load movement and ensure safe execution
Build and dismantle rigging equipment and hoists
Use mechanical load shifting equipment and associated tools, such as winches, hoists and other lifting equipment, to lift, lower, move, position and secure objects
Maintain and repair rigging gear
Record completed work orders and report issues or hazards

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Minimum 3 years working experience as a Rigger or in the same field
In-depth knowledge of rigging equipment, machinery, and safety protocols is essential. This includes the ability to perform load calculations
As this job is physically demanding, you must have physical strength and the ability required to lift heavy equipment and work long hours in various weather conditions and at heights
Strong communication, problem-solving, and spatial awareness
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

We're after a good tradesman. Someone who turns up on time, works hard, communicates well, takes pride in their work, and wants to help build something properly from the ground up.

If you want to be part of something from the start — not just join a business, but help shape one — this is that opportunity.

Competitive Hourly Rate

Real variety of work through long-term client relationships, not the same job on repeat
The chance to help shape a growing company and grow with it

You'll be working across a genuine variety of commercial and industrial projects (with some residential), carrying out electrical installation, fit-off, fault finding, testing, maintenance, and general project work. Because we service clients end to end, you'll get exposure to different job types rather than doing the same thing on repeat. As we grow, there's real opportunity to take on more responsibility early — leading jobs, mentoring apprentices, and helping set up how we do things.

Current QLD Electrical Licence

Manual driver's licence
Solid trade experience — early career or experienced both welcome
Strong workmanship and attention to detail
Good attitude and reliable work ethic
Comfortable across a variety of work, not just one type of job

Someone looking for a long-term role and keen to grow with a company from the start

We don't want big talkers or shortcuts — just a solid electrician who does the job properly and wants to grow with a company that's going somewhere.

About Us
We are a Brisbane-based electrical contracting business specialising in commercial and industrial work. We work across true variety, including:
Water/wastewater utilities — instrumentation, maintenance and construction on pump stations, treatment plants and more
Power station shutdown projects
High-end residential developments

Our aim is to be a solid, well-rounded electrical contractor with the skilled people to back it up. We're relationship-first — we'd rather do great work for a smaller number of good clients across a genuine variety of jobs than churn through the same repetitive work. About our client 

Kogan People Solutions has been retained by a leading automotive components manufacturer to recruit a highly focused tech professional for their automated production facility. Our client operates a state of  the art, continuous manufacturing environment where 100% of finished products undergo sophisticated, computer controlled validation before release. Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing 

Salary $80,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation  per annum.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

•	Diploma, or higher qualification in a highly related IT discipline or agreed substitute

•	Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of professional experience supporting integrated computer networks, automated software platforms, or industrial IT hardware interfaces.

•	Proven experience interpreting real-time software diagnostics, system logs, and bi-directional hardware/software integration.

•	Strong ability to diagnose computing faults rapidly under pressure to minimize production downtime. 

•	Excellent communication skills to interface with production engineers.

•	Ability to prioritise, multitask and work independently.

•	A passion for learning and staying ahead of technology trends.

•	Ability to analyse and evaluate complex IT issues.

•	High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

You will have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to be considered. 

How to Apply

If you possess the specialized IT skills required to support critical, automated industrial computing infrastructure, Kogan People Solutions wants to hear from you.
